$comment: Generated by pnpm features:sync from packages/features/src/registry.ts. Only config.deployment and config.features are constrained.

deployment.description: Which product this install is. Only OpenWork Cloud sets "cloud". Renders DEN_DEPLOYMENT.

installLinks.description: Install links: Workspace admins can create desktop install links for their organization. Renders DEN_FEATURE_INSTALL_LINKS.

mcpConnections.description: OpenWork Connect: Members see the organization's connections, marketplace capabilities on the agent rail, and the desktop Connect tab. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MCP_CONNECTIONS.

dashboardActivity.description: Dashboard activity: Organization admins see recent additions and skill updates on their dashboard instead of Quick add. Renders DEN_FEATURE_DASHBOARD_ACTIVITY.

modelsAnalytics.description: OpenWork Models task analytics: Organization admins can opt in to task analytics for OpenWork Models. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MODELS_ANALYTICS.

auditLogs.description: Audit logs: Organization admins can read and configure audit logs. Capture still needs an audit entitlement. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUDIT_LOGS.

orgManagedDashboards.description: Dashboards: Organization admins publish dashboards to members in Den and the desktop app. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ORG_MANAGED_DASHBOARDS.

slackAssistant.description: Slack Assistant: Answers Slack mentions and DMs for the organization after the Slack connector is set up. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_ASSISTANT.

slackAssistantHeadless.description: Slack Assistant: headless runtime: Answers Slack on the shared headless runner instead of each member's OpenWork Web computer. Needs the deployment's headless runner. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_ASSISTANT_HEADLESS.

headlessAutomations.description: Cloud Automations: headless runtime: Runs the organization's cloud Automations on the shared headless runner. Needs the deployment's headless runner and a plan that includes it. Renders DEN_FEATURE_HEADLESS_AUTOMATIONS.

workbot.description: Workbot: Members can use Workbot. Needs the deployment's Workbot app. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT.

litellm.description: AI Gateway: LiteLLM: Organization admins can connect their own LiteLLM proxy to AI Gateway, with one shared key, each person's own key, or keys OpenWork creates for each person. Renders DEN_FEATURE_LITELLM.

permissions.description: Permissions: Organization admins choose what members, admins and each team can do, instead of the fixed Member and Admin defaults. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PERMISSIONS.

permissionRules.description: Permission rules: Organization admins add OpenCode permission rules to Member, Admin and team permissions for the commands, websites, local skills and local MCP servers members' apps may use. Needs Permissions. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PERMISSION_RULES.

platformAuditReads.description: Platform audit: read-only requests: Platform administrators also get evidence of successful read-only platform requests (session reads, discovery documents). Applies to the whole deployment; organization overrides have no effect. Renders DEN_FEATURE_PLATFORM_AUDIT_READS.
